lines.text: Doing your job description is not quiet quitting. It's the job.
They didn't lay you off. They freed you from a sinking ship.
AI won't take your job. The person using AI will.
Protect your peace like it's the last seat on the lifeboat.
Tired is not a personality trait. Take the PTO.

Promotions don't go to the busiest person.
They go to the most visible one.

Your boss isn't your friend.
Your boss is on the layoff committee.

Six months of savings is more leverage
than ten years of loyalty.

Hustle culture made millionaires of CEOs
and burnouts of employees.

Loyalty to a company that wouldn't replace you in a week
is not virtue.

Your value didn't decrease
the day they cut your role.

If your boss stopped asking your opinion,
update your resume.

The complainer in every 1:1
gets cut first.

Quiet firing is the new
performance review.

Three signs your role is about to be eliminated.
Save this.

Work hard in silence.
Let your success make the noise.
No is a complete sentence.
Stop watering dead plants.

What's meant for you
won't pass you by.

Healing isn't linear.
And look how far you've come.
Self-respect first.
Quiet confidence.
You can't pour from an empty cup.
Hurt people hurt people.
Romanticize your life.
Your peace is your power.

Soft life.
Hard boundaries.
Your vibe attracts your tribe.
Self love isn't selfish.
Confidence unlocked.

The only way to do great work
is to love what you do.

Don't stop when you're tired.
Stop when you're done.

Be yourself.
Everyone else is already taken.
Comparison is the thief of joy.
Discipline equals freedom.

She believed she could,
so she did.
